options.what: QuartzCore's bool debug options: init_debug stores option N at _ca_debug_options + N (the plug-in writes and reads two of them, DisplayWide.inc one); this build has 300 (24A446: 293), and the two are 1 and 3 later than in 24A446

no_address: RenderBox, WebGPU and ANGLE are told a GPU family by the caller's image path (dladdr), no address. The CADeviceIsVirtualized block (0x18442e290 here, 0x184541f10 in 24A446) is named in comments only, as sub_184541f10. The frontend's quartzCoreCallers diagnostic holds offsets of the iOS 17 (21H461) QuartzCore; it only reads, inside QuartzCore's image, and is left as upstream has it. /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/RenderBox.framework/RenderBox, .../WebGPU.framework/WebGPU and .../WebCore.framework/Frameworks/libANGLE-shared.dylib are in this cache's image list under those paths, as in 24A446's.
